Smart Fog Vision
AI Dehazing & Hazard Alert System

Real-time, browser-only driver assistance: captures foggy video, restores visibility with Dark Channel Prior + guided filter + CLAHE, then runs YOLOv8 / COCO-SSD, distance estimation, IOU tracking and voice alerts. No server, no API key — all on-device.

Why it matters

Fog causes 30%+ of weather-related crashes in India. Existing ADAS needs expensive LiDAR. Smart Fog Vision does it with a single webcam/phone camera — enhancing the feed in real time so drivers (and YOLO) can see hazards earlier.

Fog Detection
Dark Channel Prior mean + contrast variance → fog %, visibility (m), level (HIGH→VERY LOW).
Dehazing
DCP transmission t=1-ω·dark/A, box-blur guided filter, scene recovery J=(I-A)/t+A, CLAHE gain + unsharp mask.
YOLO + Tracking + Distance
COCO-SSD / YOLOv8n ONNX (80 classes) → IOU tracker (thr 0.32, maxAge 15) → pinhole dist=f·H/bboxH → hazard levels.
Alerts
DANGER <12m • WARNING <25m • CAUTION <45m. Top banner + log + Web Speech throttled voice (“Brake! Car ahead 12 meters”).
He et al. DCP (2009) TF.js ONNX Runtime Web COCO • 80 classes Web Speech API No server
Interview talking point: “Explain how you estimated atmospheric light A and why t₀=0.1 avoids halo artifacts.” — Ready answer in README.

Why it matters

Every year thousands of missing-person reports go unmatched due to manual checks. CHRONO automates it: encodes faces with FaceNet (128-D), scores similarity with Cosine, fuses location & demographic signals, and surfaces ranked matches for authorities — securely.

Face Encoding
FaceNet (Keras/TF) → 128-D embeddings, L2-normalized, stored in MySQL with indexed vector search.
Matching
Cosine Similarity >0.62 threshold + location telemetry + demographic rerank → >90% accuracy. Multi-modal fusion.
Secure Backend
Spring Boot REST (JWT), MySQL optimized indexes, confidential storage, rapid retrieval for sensitive records.
Live Deployment
Deployed on Render at chrono-j9pf.onrender.com — Java 17, Maven, Docker-ready, CI via GitHub.
